description: Pinned upstream vectors, regenerated by scripts/import-crypto-vectors.mjs. Read by @kokuin/crypto-conformance and crates/kokuin-crypto/tests/external.rs. `valid` is the expected outcome under this project policy; `upstream` keeps the source verdict. blake3 inputs are `inputLength` bytes of the repeating sequence 0..250, and `hash` is the first 131 bytes of output.

supercop-ed25519.note: SUPERCOP ed25519 sign.input. Entries 0-2 are RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1-3.
